name: Bulk evaluation throttled in a developer environment
symptom: Observe and record: slow answers, evaluation cases that end in errors rather than wrong answers, rate or capacity messages in the test pane, especially when a large test set is run twice in HLE-Dev.
cause: Generative AI message rate is 10 RPM / 200 RPH on trial and developer environments (100 RPM / 2,000 RPH on pay-as-you-go); one test case can use more than one generative request.
fix: Split test sets (about 10 rows) and wait between runs in HLE-Dev; run full regression in the HLE-Test sandbox; record error-only cases as skipped and re-run; check consumption first.

name: Course CSV rejected by the test set import
symptom: Observe and record: the raw course CSV, or a converted file with the wrong header, is rejected or imports no questions; with troubleshooting notes left in expected responses, correct answers are scored low.
cause: Agent evaluation supports CSV import, but the exact columns and any row limit are UNVERIFIED for this course; the course format also contains behaviors a text comparison cannot grade.
fix: Convert with ConvertTo-CopilotStudioTestSet.ps1, match testset-column-map.json targets to the template on the evaluation page, keep stopAt markers, exclude observe and action_called rows.

name: Test pane and evaluation run as the maker
symptom: The test pane answers CAD 105,000 for grade G7 while Sofia Brennan correctly gets no answer; a fin test set fails its no-answer cases because the run uses the maker's identity (observe and record whether your version can choose another identity).
cause: With Authenticate with Microsoft, knowledge is trimmed to the signed-in user; the learner is in every course group, including HR, so holds EXTRACT rights on the labeled file. Connector ACLs can also deny the maker what a persona sees.
fix: Grade persona rows only as that persona in the published channel; keep test sets persona-specific; use a dedicated test account per persona if evaluation supports choosing an identity.

name: Evaluation looks different in the classic and new experiences
symptom: Observe and record: agent evaluation is labeled GA in one experience and preview in the other; menus, grading methods and test sets may differ or not carry across.
cause: Microsoft documents Copilot Studio in two parallel page sets that disagree on the status of agent evaluation (CONFLICT).
fix: Record the experience and status with each result; do not use a preview feature as a release gate; keep Invoke-EvalReport.ps1 results as the source of truth; re-check both pages each cohort.
